caseName: Girten Investment Co. v. Kansas ex rel. Anderson
caseNameFull: Girten Investment Co. v. Kansas ex rel. Anderson, Attorney General
attorneys: Hugh B. Cox, J. E. Schroeder, T. M. Lillard and O. B. Eidson for petitioners. John Anderson, Jr., Attorney-General of Kansas, Charles S. Rhyne and Herzel H. E. Plaine for respondents. John B. Cullen for George Docking, Governor of Kansas.

opinions.text: The motion of George Docking, Governor of Kansas, for leave to file brief, as amicus curiae, is granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Kansas denied.
